_comment: Canonical single source for the OpenUPM scoped registry, pinned comparison-benchmark and sample-integration package versions, required Unity built-in module packages, and package-specific asmdef define symbols. Consumed by scripts/unity/run-ci-tests.ps1 and the committed .unity-test-project/Packages/manifest.json (local parity). EditMode CI installs integrationPackages so every conditional DI sample body compiles against a real dependency. Bump versions/modules/defines here only and keep both consumers in sync. Unity 6000.5 requires MessagePipe 1.8.2+ and Reflex 14.3.1+ for generic TreeView APIs, plus Unity Atoms 4.6.2+ for Object.GetEntityId(). See .llm/skills/test-code-quality/references/comparison-parity-and-package-single-source.md.
